text: 金十数据8月19日讯，盈方微公告，公司拟以发行股份及支付现金的方式购买上海肖克利信息科技股份有限公司100%股份并募集配套资金，近日收到国家市场监督管理总局出具的决定书，对本次收购股权案不实施进一步审查，公司可即日起实施集中。本次交易尚需履行深圳证券交易所审核通过、中国证监会同意注册等多项审批程序，能否通过审批及最终获批时间尚存在不确定性。
text_en: Jin10 Data August 19 - Infomicro announced it plans to acquire 100% of Shanghai Xiaokele Information Technology Co., Ltd. via share issuance and cash payment, along with raising matching funds. It recently received a decision from the State Administration for Market Regulation approving the acquisition without further review, allowing immediate implementation. The transaction still requires Shenzhen Stock Exchange approval and CSRC registration, with uncertainty over approval timing.
